title: How to Watch the Wimbledon Championships 2026 Live Online for Free
summary: Serena Williams returns to Wimbledon, which starts on Monday (June 29). Here's where to livestream the tennis tournament without cable.
contentText:

The 139th edition of the Wimbledon Championships features the best and brightest tennis players from around the world, including Jannik Sinner, Carlos Alcaraz, Aryna Sabalenka, Coco Gauff and others. In fact, Serena Williams is slated to play in her first Grand Slam since 2022 as an unseeded wild card. She won the Wimbledon singles title in 2016.

The tennis tournament takes place in London, England, starting on Monday (June 29) and broadcasts live across ESPN , ESPN2 and ABC .

How to Watch 2026 Wimbledon Championships Live Online, At a Glance:

- Dates: June 29-July 12

- Network: ESPN, ESPN2, ABC

- Online Streaming: DirecTV , Hulu + Live TV , Sling TV , Fubo , ESPN Unlimited

Watch 2026 Wimbledon Championships on DirecTV

Which Celebrities Are Making Appearances During Wimbledon Championships?

It’s likely there may be a number of celebrities and famous recording artists in attendance during Wimbledon in London. Be on the lookout for celebrity tennis fans who’ve been seen at Wimbledon or other tennis matches before — like Zendaya, Taylor Swift, Dave Grohl , Harry Styles, and Prince William and Kate Middleton.

How to Watch the 2026 Wimbledon Championships Live Online

The Wimbledon Championships take place at All England Lawn Tennis and Croquet Club in London, England. The Grand Slam begins on Monday (June 29), with first serve at 6 a.m. ET/3 a.m. PT (11 a.m. BST). Matches broadcast on ESPN, ESPN2 and ABC.

Serena Williams is expected to play in a ladies’ wild card match on Monday (June 29) or Tuesday (June 30). In addition, Williams and her sister Venus Williams are also due to get a wild card match into the ladies’ doubles tennis tournament, which begins on Thursday (July 2). Both matches air on ESPN. Check out a complete schedule of gentlemen’s, ladies’, doubles and mixed doubles matches here .

If you don’t have cable, you can still watch live online with a free trial from DirecTV , Hulu + Live TV and Fubo .

The plan features more than 200 other channels, including the Tennis Channel, FOX Sports, NBA TV, MLB.TV, MLB Network, NHL Network, NFL Network and others. Fubo comes with a five-day free trial , so you can try out the service before you commit month-to-month.
